POL-CMP-01: Customer Complaint Handling Standard Operating Procedure
Category: Customer Relations | Version: v2.1 | Status: Active | Effective: 2024-01-01

heading: 1.0 Purpose and Scope
content: This procedure sets mandatory requirements for receiving, logging, triage, and resolving complaints across NovaTech Global retail, online e-commerce, and electronics divisions.

heading: 2.0 Initial Response SLA
content: All submitted complaints must receive an immediate automated acknowledgment and be reviewed by an agent within 4 hours for P1/P2 issues and within 1 hour for P0 critical safety issues.

heading: 3.0 Prohibited Commitments
content: Agents must NEVER guarantee refunds, monetary compensation, or product replacements in initial responses without prior ground-truth validation and manager sign-off.

Compliance Committee within 30 minutes. Frontline agents are strictly forbidden from
dismissing safety reports.
